title: Datadog Review (2026)
intro: Datadog is evaluated here as an observability and infrastructure monitoring suite — Datadog is an observability and monitoring platform spanning infrastructure metrics, APM/tracing, log management, and related security/RUM modules. Infrastructure Pro publishes from $15/host/month on annual billing as a common entry host floor; APM, logs, and other products add module-specific consumption charges. Free tier exists for limited hosts/metrics. Pricing is usage- and module-heavy — confirm live calculators before purchase. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Datadog when observability — infrastructure, APM, and logs — is the primary job and you can model module/consumption TCO.
verdict: Choose Datadog when observability — infrastructure, APM, and logs — is the primary job and you can model module/consumption TCO. Compare Freshservice for ITSM, GitHub for source control (landscape only), and specialist log/APM tools if you need a narrower SKU. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Datadog’s breadth (infra, APM, logs, security) raises admin learning curve versus single-purpose tools — powerful but not trivial for tiny teams.
Category-leading fit for observability-monitoring — infrastructure metrics, APM/tracing, and log management are the core published jobs.
Dashboards, monitors, SLOs, tracing, and log pipelines provide deep SRE/observability workflows when modules are purchased.
Extensive cloud, CI, chat, and on-call integrations are a core Datadog promise — strong ecosystem for modern stacks.
Enterprise RBAC, audit logs, SSO/SCIM, and compliance posture are marketed for regulated buyers.
Built for cloud-scale host/log/span volume with enterprise commits — scales well with budget.
Published $15/host floor looks approachable, but multi-module consumption TCO escalates quickly — value score reflects calculator complexity, not affiliate economics.
Watchdog, Bits AI, and anomaly features are published observability AI — useful SRE assistance with module/usage packaging.

notIdealFor: Buyers whose primary job is ITSM ticketing (Freshservice)
